Extract of proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court for Monday, 3rd. June 1930.
Case No. 576/30 Station 3099 Prosecutor Judge McNeill

Accused: Tsang Ta Ji ( ) Age 30. Secretary.

Application: Application is made for the custody of the accused on a charge of being member of a gang of communist bandits, operating in the vicinity of Kong Ying, Kiangsu. Compt.-Kong Ping Sung, Inspector of Bandit Suppression Force.

Proceedings:
Mr. Paul du appeared for the Police.
Mr. Hui:-The accused was arrested at 6a.m. 31- -1. He is wanted by the Chinese authorities as they allege that he is a communist bandit & has committed many crimes at Kong Ying, Kiangsu. The representative has brought no despatch warrant & no evidence so I ask the Court to remand the case for further inquiries.
Rep. Tong Ping Sung:-I received information that the accused is a communist & bandit & has committed many crimes at Kong Ying & he is implicated by another man arrested at Kong Ying last year, & when he knew that he was wanted he ran away to Shanghai.
Wit. Tan Ti Chang:-I know the accused, he is a communist & a bandit. He belongs to a gang who demand money, if they do not get it they set fire & then burn the houses.
Wit. Too Pon Fung:-I am a detective at Kong Ying, I belong to the same family as the unt of accused. His real name is Zung Zau Yoong, I know his uncle, too Kwai Seong. The accused is a communist & a bandit & has committed many crimes.
Wit. Jan Yan Pao:-I do not know accused I only helped to arrest him.
Accused:-My name is not Zung Zau Yoong & I have no uncle named Lee Kwai Seong. I know nothing about communists or bandits & I have never committed any crimes at Kong Ying.
Mr. Hui:-I ask the Court to remand the case for the appearance of Lee Kwai Seong.

Decision: Remand till 11-6-31 a.m. for trial
L.R.
（签名）

上海特区地方法院庭审记录摘录，日期为 1930年6月3日星期一。
案件编号 576/30 捕房 3099 检察官 法官 McNeill

被告： Tsang Ta Ji ( ) 年龄 30岁。秘书。

申请： 申请羁押被告，指控其为在江苏孔营附近活动的共产主义匪帮成员。申请人 - Kong Ping Sung，剿匪部队督察。

庭审过程：
Paul du 先生代表警方出庭。
Hui 先生：- 被告于凌晨6点被捕，日期为 31- -1。中国当局通缉他，因为他们声称他是共产主义匪徒，并在江苏孔营犯下多起罪行。代表未带来递解令状，也未提供证据，因此我请求法庭将案件延期审理，以便进一步调查。
代表 Tong Ping Sung：- 我收到情报称被告是共产主义者和匪徒，并在孔营犯下多起罪行，且去年在孔营被捕的另一名男子供出了他，当他得知自己被通缉后，便逃往上海。
证人 Tan Ti Chang：- 我认识被告，他是共产主义者和匪徒。他属于一个勒索钱财的团伙，如果得不到钱，他们就放火烧毁房屋。
证人 Too Pon Fung：- 我是孔营的一名侦探，我与被告的叔叔同宗。他的真名是 Zung Zau Yoong，我认识他的叔叔 Too Kwai Seong。被告是共产主义者和匪徒，并犯下多起罪行。
证人 Jan Yan Pao：- 我不认识被告，我只是协助逮捕了他。
被告：- 我的名字不是 Zung Zau Yoong，我也没有名叫 Lee Kwai Seong 的叔叔。我对共产主义者或匪徒一无所知，也从未在孔营犯下任何罪行。
Hui 先生：- 我请求法庭延期审理，以待 Lee Kwai Seong 出庭。

裁决： 延期至 31年6月11日上午 受审
L.R.
（签名）

My name is Tsang Ts Ji ( 张 之 棋 ) I am a native of North
Gate, Dung Zung Hsien, Anwhei, aged 30, single and employed
as a clerk in the Tsung Koong Yah Yau ( 尊 孔 学 校 )
Confucius School, No 917 Hanbury Road, where I reside.
At the age of eight I began to study in the Anwhei Middle
School at Dung Zung ( 桐 城 ) I took up the study of
Chinese classics and English and continued to study until I
was 23 years of age . During my period of schooling I res-
ided at home with my parents, Tsang Kung Loong ( 张 广 龙 )
my father and Tsang Tau Sze ( 张 道 氏 ) my mother.
I have a very fair knowledge of the Chinese language and
can read and write a little English , but am at present out
of practice in the la.ter language. My father paid all my
school fees and when I left at the age of 23 I continued to
live with my parents in Dung Zung ( 桐 城 ) In the year
1930 I asked permission to come to Shanghai and eventually
left for this city on February 22nd arriving here by steamer
on February 25th. Mt father did not wish me to leave home
as he operates a rice shop in Dung Zung and is in a fair way
of business. I came to Shanghai at the advice of one Tsong
Zing Nyoch ( 章 静 玉 ) aged about 27, native of Shanghai,
I met this man in my native place some years ago and kept
in touch with him. Early last year he wrote to me and told me
that he had obtained a position as a teacher in the Tsung
Koong Yah Yau school ( 尊 孔 学 校 ) and asked me to come to
Shanghai and take up the position of clerk for the school.
On arrival in Shanghai on February 25th 1930 I went straight

我叫 Tsang Ts Ji ( 张 之 棋 ) ，我是安徽桐城县北门人，现年30岁，未婚，受雇于汉密尔顿路917号尊孔学校 ( Tsung Koong Yah Yau ) 担任职员，我就住在那里。
八岁时，我开始在安徽桐城中学就读。我研习中国经典和英语，并持续学习直到23岁。在求学期间，我与父母同住家中，父亲是 Tsang Kung Loong ( 张 广 龙 ) ，母亲是 Tsang Tau Sze ( 张 道 氏 ) 。
我的中文知识相当不错，能读写少量英语，但目前后者生疏了。我的父亲支付了我所有的学费，当我23岁离校后，我继续与父母住在桐城。1930年，我请求允许来上海，最终于2月22日离开此地，并于2月25日乘轮船抵达。我父亲不希望我离家，因为他在桐城经营一家米店，生意尚可。我来上海是听从一位名叫 Tsong Zing Nyoch ( 章 静 玉 ) 的建议，他约27岁，上海人。我几年前在家乡认识此人，并一直保持联系。去年年初，他写信给我，告诉我他已在尊孔学校 ( Tsung Koong Yah Yau ) 获得教师职位，并邀请我来上海担任该校职员。
1930年2月25日抵达上海后，我直接前往

Despatch from the Shanghai Special District Court.
No. 6950.                                      June    5,      1.

To Commissioner of Police,
           S. M. P.

Sir,

        I have to inform you that I am in receipt of a
letter No.679 from the Kiangsu Provincial Government
informing me the arrest of a gang of communists in
Kiang-ying and also forwarding a list of names and
particulars of those who are at large. I have to
request that you be good enough to give instructions
to the various police stations to effect the arrest
of these persons whose names and particulars are given
in the attached list.                          before
                                              They are to be brought this
Court when they are arrested.

                        President Yang Shao Shun.

第6950号。                                      1931年6月5日。

致警务处处长，
           上海公共租界工部局警务处。

先生：

        兹通知阁下，本人收到江苏省政府第679号来函，告知在江阴（Kiang-ying）逮捕了一伙共产党员，并附上了在逃人员的名单及详细资料。现请阁下惠予指令各捕房，依据附件名单中所列姓名及资料，逮捕相关人员。
                                              这些人被捕后须解送至本
                                              法院。

                        院长 杨绍顺。
